title: They are the size of a Quarter !!!!!!!!!!
text: They are the size of a Quarter !!!!!!!!!!. The  description is very misleading..... The photo of the item impresses the buyer so much that I bought another set for a friend. Whether the dimensions are on the box or not, The stock photo is what influences a buyer. All in all, NOT impressed
